codes.uiTreatment: Block the commit. Name the excluded administrators and offer the narrowing remedy inline.
Offer 'Preview again'. Show what changed by kind. Never auto-retry the commit.
Block the commit. Surface the degradation reasons and state that counts were lower bounds.

Field-level error on the subject picker, with suggestions when available.
Field-level error on the scope picker.
Field-level error spanning subject and scope; offer the alternative scopes.
Force a re-preview and require an explicit decision on each newly registered permission.
Disable the commit control with this reason; name the missing permissions. Prefer surfacing it via preview.commitBlocked before the user attempts a commit.
Explain that the actor's own authority changed; the draft is preserved, not invalid.
Offer reload-and-reapply. Show who changed it and which fields conflict. Never silently overwrite.
Explain the recovery state and that no in-product re-enable exists. Offer the recreate path.
Adjacent-domain surfaces only. Link to the impact preview; do not offer a force-through.
